section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the participants and procedure for a single study involving 238 college students (160 women, 78 men) with a mean age of 20.87 years, recruited from introductory psychology classes at a large Midwestern university and a community college. Participants completed paper-and-pencil measures in classroom settings or after class, with 91.6% identifying as Caucasian. The study examined attitudes toward body and eating behavior, with measures counterbalanced to control for order effects.
